description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice Calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the appointment of judicial mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for mediator positions (Chairman of Panel of Mediators and Mediators) under the Mediation Boards Act, specifying eligibility criteria and appointment procedures for these quasi-judicial roles. This fits Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) as it deals with court-related appointments and the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the justice system.
